note: Registry data could not be verified: the search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unreachable for the whole session ('Connection refused'), Bing returned only irrelevant results, and all registry aggregators attempted (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, instafinancials.com, quickcompany.in) returned 403/404, while the company's own site (trinitytouch.com) was behind a bot-verification wall and IndiaMART returned 429. Therefore CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status and audited revenue FY25/FY26 are all null - NOT because they do not exist, but because they were not publicly retrievable with the tools available. No rejection is applied: there is no evidence the entity is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt, and absence of verification is not a ground for rejection under the project rules. Role left as 'unknown' (the company is widely described as a manufacturer/trader of electrical and instrumentation products, but that is a catalogue claim, not a registry fact, and per the rules catalogue claims are not treated as confirmed). Declared HS 847190 (IT/electronics) is retained in the record without any HS-based verdict; if the actual product line is electrical/instrumentation, the code should be corrected to the factual one at the next verification pass. Recommended next step: re-run verification when search access is restored, using MCA master data (CIN lookup), the GST public search portal for GSTIN/status, and audited FY25/FY26 filings for revenue.
